raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart displays the area of land (in hectares) for different countries or regions over a period of years from 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, with each year marked from 2013 to 2022, and the vertical axis represents the area in hectares, ranging from 0 to 1200 with intervals of 200. Each year has a group of seven stacked bars, each corresponding to a different country or region: Spain (blue), France (orange), China/continental (gray), Italy (yellow), Turkey (light blue), USA (green), and Argentina (dark blue). The legend on the right side of the chart identifies the color associated with each country or region. The bars for each year are arranged in the same order, with Spain having the tallest bar in most years, followed by France, China/continental, Italy, Turkey, USA, and Argentina. The values for each country vary slightly from year to year, but the general pattern remains consistent across the years.
